sections.name: Espresso
tasks: Place portafilter on the grinder nozzle to start automatic grinding of coffee beans (18.0g-18.8g).
Place the portafilter with the coffee grind into the automatic tamper(PUQ PRESS)After tamping, wipe away any excess ground coffee.
Then fit the group handle containing tamped grind firmly to the grouphead of the espresso machine.
Place the serving cup under the portafilter and allow the extract to Espresso 34 to 36 Grams into it,Extraction usually takes 20-30 seconds.

sections.name: Steaming
tasks: Fully submerge yourpitcher right to the bottom of the spout with cold milk.Fully submerge your thermometer into the milk.
Turn on your machine's steam function and purge the steam wand.When you're ready to start.
Turn on your espresso machine and allow it to heat to its normal brewing temperature. Place the steam wand just below the surface of the milk.
Open the steam valve to full blast.
Expand the milk 30°C-40°C
Lower steam wand and heat up to 60°C
Clean it up the steaming wand when finished.
Cappuccino: (PUQ PRESS). After tamping,wipe any excess ground coffee (18.0g-18.8g).
Cappuccino: Insert and gently lock the portafilter into espresso machine group head.Place the desired cup size under the portafilter to start extraction.
Cappuccino: Pour the for 9oz 160g & for 12oz 200g amount of fresh milk into the pitcher.
Cappuccino: While extracting the espresso for 9oz 34g-36g & for 12oz 49g-51g, steam the milk up to 60°C.
Cappuccino: Pour the steamed milk into the cup with espresso on it.
Cappuccino: Finish with an art. (Total weight: 9oz-194g-196g/12oz-249g-251g)
Cappuccino: Serve coffee with smile and advise customer to condiments bar.

sections.name: Signature Base Mix
tasks: Start by placing an empty and clean blender jug to scale and tare.
Pump 180g of sweet sauce into the tared blender jug.
